svg.title: How one ConvictionDesk research task runs
svg.desc: Six steps left to right. Scope freezes holdings, account and cutoff. Typed read-only tools gather portfolio, SEC, price and news evidence with a receipt per call. Bounded model calls for intent and assessment return typed JSON citing evidence IDs (scripted in the keyless demo). Code validates citations, cutoff, numbers and units, and saves a failed round on failure. The result is an immutable hash-checked revision; Deep appends a second round. A Decimal what-if previews one account; there is no order API. Steps 2 to 5 write an execution trace. A 31-case frozen eval corpus replays the guards with zero model calls.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ONE RESEARCH TASK · TYPED PYTHON LOOP · NO AGENT FRAMEWORK
